svg.title: What the layout parser checks, and what it silently accepts
svg.desc: Animated: a four-node illustrative layout parsed by Layout::Layout, then five faults that load without an error (an edge to an unknown id, a duplicate node id, a misspelt optional key, a heading listed with its reciprocal, an empty VRC node list), the checks that do throw, and a summary of checked versus not checked.
svg.metadata: ["A valid four-node layout. The parser stores the nodes in nodes_, sorts them by id, and numbers them: node_id_to_index_ maps id 2, 4, 6, 8 to index 0, 1, 2, 3. graph_ is a Boost graph over those indices; each YAML edge becomes add_edge(node_id_to_index_[a], node_id_to_index_[b]).", "(a) An edge to an id that does not exist: {src: 6, dst: 99}. node_id_to_index_ is a std::map and operator[] inserts the missing key with value 0, so 99 -> 0 and the edge joins node 6 to index 0, the lowest id (Bay 2). HasNode(99) is now true and GetNodeById(99) returns node 2's data. PoseGraph then puts both 4 and 2 into the LEFT slot of (6, 90) and only logs \"silent loss of an edge\".", "(b) A second node with id 4. Both copies stay in nodes_ (indices 1 and 2, in an unspecified order: std::sort is not stable). The index loop is last-wins, so id 4 maps to 2 and the copy at index 1 is unreachable by id but still produces poses: (4, -90) and (4, 90) exist twice, and node 4 is listed under both Waypoint and Parking in node_ids_by_type_.", "(c) A typo in an optional key: faces_reciprocol: true. The parser only looks up the keys it knows, so faces_reciprocal stays false and nothing is reported. Bay 2's inbound heading becomes 90 instead of Wrap(270) = -90, and GetBayOutboundPose(2) finds no LEFT neighbour of (2, 90): nullopt instead of (4, -90). Every optional key behaves this way.", "(d) A heading listed with its reciprocal: headings: [0, 180] on node 6. GetAllowedHeadings adds h and Wrap(h + 180) for each entry, so node 6 gets 0, 0, 180, 180: four poses, two of them duplicates (pose_indices_ keeps the first). And because 4 and 8 allow only 90 and -90, the edges 4-6 and 6-8 produce no pose edges at all, also without a message.", "(e) A VRC with an empty node list. The loop bound vrc.nodes.size() - 1 is unsigned: 0 - 1 wraps to SIZE_MAX, the loop runs and reads vrc.nodes[0] and vrc.nodes[1] of an empty vector, which is undefined behaviour (in practice a crash, or garbage ids that operator[] inserts as in (a)). root_node is never checked against the node list.", "What IS checked: an unknown node type, an unknown max_resource_size, windows that are smaller than TRAY, do not nest or are equal, height_m above kBayHeight, an unknown VRC node id, and (in PoseGraph) a node without headings and an off-axis shared-heading edge. A missing required key throws from yaml-cpp, without naming the node.", "Summary. Required keys and enumerated values are checked; references between parts of the file (edge ids, duplicate ids, VRC lists), optional key names and heading sets are not. The five faulty lines are in layout.cpp, pose_utils.cpp and pose_graph.cpp; a lint pass or .at() instead of operator[] would catch (a), (b) and (e) at load."]
